attributes.name: The Missing Eye
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Strength or Melee skill + 1d8+1; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 1d6 plus the scenario's adventure deck number and the Cold trait. If the bane has the Demon trait, add another 1d6 plus the scenario's adventure deck number. If not proficient with weapons, the difficulty of this check is increased by 4.

Discard this card to add 1d6 to your Fortitude or Perception check.
